title: Internet Packages in Danvers, MA: Xfinity vs Verizon Fios
description: Internet packages in Danvers, MA (01923): Xfinity and Verizon Fios prices, price locks, autopay rules and fees compared, plus FCC coverage data.
lead: The two packages most Danvers homes choose between, and the fine print that changes what you really pay.
short_answer: Most Danvers homes choose between Xfinity cable, which reaches most of the 01923 ZIP code with up to 2 Gbps download, and Verizon Fios fiber, which reaches most of it with near-equal upload and download. Astound reaches only a small part. Compare price-lock length, autopay rules and whether taxes are included, not just the headline price.

sections.body_html: Xfinity prices are from its Danvers page on November 25, 2026 (new customers; offer dated to end November 30). Fios prices are from Verizon's Massachusetts page, which does not name Danvers, so confirm at your address. Neither is a guaranteed quote.

Both companies discount internet when you add their mobile service. Verizon says bundling Fios with a Verizon mobile plan saves up to $15 a month. Xfinity's Danvers page lists Xfinity Mobile from $30 a month with Xfinity Internet and its StreamSaver streaming bundle at $18 a month. A bundle only saves money if you would buy those services anyway, so price the internet plan alone first.

sections.h2: Fios in Danvers is backed by a town license
sections.body_html: The Danvers Select Board renewed Verizon's cable TV license for August 2024 to August 2029. It covers the entire town, with limited exceptions, and Verizon must connect homes within 150 feet of its fiber network at its own cost. That is the TV license, but Fios internet runs on the same fiber network, and Fios reaches most of the town in the FCC data.

sections.h2: Every provider reporting service in Danvers (01923)

sections.body_html: Source: FCC Broadband Data Collection, June 30, 2026, matched to ZIP codes by YourBillCheck. Footprint compares each provider's reported locations with the widest land-based (wired or fixed wireless) provider near that ZIP code, so it is a guide, not a promise for your street.

Astound reports cable up to 1.5 Gbps in only a small part of the ZIP code. 5G home internet: T-Mobile reaches a large part of town in the FCC data but at up to 25 Mbps; AT&T and Verizon wireless reach smaller parts. Starlink reports up to 280 Mbps; with two wired networks covering most of Danvers, few homes need it.

faq: What internet providers are available in Danvers, MA?
Xfinity cable and Verizon Fios fiber cover most of the 01923 ZIP code. Astound cable reaches a small part. T-Mobile, AT&T and Verizon wireless and satellite are also available.
Yes. Verizon reports fiber across most of 01923 with speeds up to 940 Mbps down and 880 Mbps up, and holds a town-wide cable license through August 2029.
What is the cheapest internet package in Danvers?
On November 25, 2026, Verizon listed Fios 300 Mbps at $30 a month with Auto Pay on its Massachusetts page, and Xfinity listed 300 Mbps at $45 a month with autopay and paperless billing.
Is Xfinity or Verizon Fios better in Danvers?

Fios has much faster uploads and Verizon says its prices include taxes and fees. Xfinity reports up to 2 Gbps download in the FCC data and offers a 5-year price guarantee; Verizon also markets 2 Gig and 5 Gig Fios plans in Massachusetts. Compare both at your address.
